findings.description: `save(p)` adds a photo to `saveAll.handed` only after its share promise resolves, while `saveAll.tap()` neither tracks nor excludes a per-photo share in progress. If someone taps a received photo and then taps Save all before that share settles, the batch includes the same photo and starts another share operation; a concurrent-share rejection also incorrectly puts Save all into download-on-next-tap mode.
findings.title: A pending photo can be shared twice

findings.description: `tap()` announces `Downloading ${ready.length}` before starting the files, then catches each synchronous download failure with only a console warning. When a download call throws, that file remains eligible for retry but the page gives no indication that its download never started.
findings.title: Users aren't told when downloads fail
